image_description: A vintage-style comic book cover featuring a group of four characters in red and black costumes looking upwards. Above them is a large yellow explosion cloud with red text, and a flying character in white/grey. The top features a bold, stylized title logo. There are speech bubbles and caption boxes visible.

Facial features are somewhat smudged and lack the crisp line work typical of professional comic inking, appearing slightly 'painted' or soft-focused rather than drawn.
